title: MemoryRecord
description: One cross-run memory. Stored in SQLite, searched with FTS5. Supporting context only: a memory never overrides a repository fact.

workspaceId.description: Stable id for the workspace. Retrieval is always filtered by this; memories never leak across workspaces.

kind.description: Procedural memory is deliberately absent. A workflow worth keeping is promoted to a SKILL.md, an AGENTS.md rule, a stack profile, or a deterministic check, not stored here.

content.description: One fact, stated plainly. Hedged content ('probably needs Redis') fails the policy filter.

status.description: Model output can only produce 'proposed'. Only a verifier result or a human event moves a record to 'confirmed'.

sourceType.description: How the memory was obtained. 'model_inference' is deliberately absent.

sourceRef.description: Pointer to the originating run and event, for example 'run_2026-07-29T10-22-03Z_loop-graph-runtime/events.ndjson#42'.

evidence.description: Concrete observations supporting the content. Empty evidence is rejected by the policy filter.

supersedesId.description: When set, the referenced record moves to 'stale' on confirmation.

usedCount.description: Successful reuses. Repeated reuse triggers a promotion proposal to a durable rule; the runtime proposes, it does not write the rule.
